title: Case: Failed delivery has returned to sender and the customer still wants the order
context: The failed original delivery is physically back at the merchant. The recipient still wants the item and has confirmed the existing delivery details.
initial_request: I still want the order. I checked my authenticated order details: Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk, Merrow Quay is correct. Please ask for reshipment there.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant to approve reshipment to the customer's verified delivery details.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Thistlecombe Goods that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant to approve reshipment to the customer's verified delivery details. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: New shipment reference does not prove dispatch or receipt; do not reuse the old delivered status.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
Treats the claim from Aurelio Normanton (who has no recorded link to DL-53081) as confirmed
Closes the case or tells anyone the matter is resolved on the strength of Aurelio Normanton's message
expected.reference_message: Please approve reshipment of TG-8439 to Caspar’s unchanged verified order destination, Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk. Warehouse confirms the original item is back and reshippable.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-038: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. An unverified bystander, Aurelio Normanton, claims something that would end the case; it is not a record and the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
